sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.Tags FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes' AND p.CommentCount = 0 AND p.Tags IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.Tags

WITH RECURSIVE tag_split(tag, rest) AS (
  SELECT substr(p.Tags, 2, instr(p.Tags, '>') - 2),
         substr(p.Tags, instr(p.Tags, '>') + 1)
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
  WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes'
    AND p.CommentCount = 0
    AND p.Tags IS NOT NULL
    AND p.Tags <> ''
    AND instr(p.Tags, '<') = 1
    AND instr(p.Tags, '>') > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT substr(rest, 2, instr(rest, '>') - 2),
         substr(rest, instr(rest, '>') + 1)
  FROM tag_split
  WHERE rest <> ''
    AND instr(rest, '>') > 0
)
SELECT DISTINCT tag
FROM tag_split
WHERE tag IS NOT NULL AND tag <> ''
ORDER BY tag;

SELECT DISTINCT t.TagName FROM posts AS p JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId JOIN tags AS t ON instr(p.Tags, '<' || t.TagName || '>') > 0 WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes' AND p.CommentCount = 0 AND p.Tags IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.TagName;

WITH RECURSIVE split(post_id, rest, tag) AS (SELECT p.Id, replace(replace(replace(p.Tags, '><', ','), '<', ''), '>', '') AS rest, NULL AS tag FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes' AND p.CommentCount = 0 AND p.Tags IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT post_id, CASE WHEN instr(rest, ',') > 0 THEN substr(rest, instr(rest, ',') + 1) ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN instr(rest, ',') > 0 THEN substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ',') - 1) ELSE rest END FROM split WHERE rest <> '') SELECT DISTINCT tag FROM split WHERE tag IS NOT NULL AND tag <> '' ORDER BY tag;

WITH RECURSIVE tag_parts(rest, tag) AS (
  SELECT p.Tags, NULL
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
  WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes'
    AND p.CommentCount = 0
    AND p.Tags IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT substr(rest, instr(rest, '>') + 1),
         substr(rest, 2, instr(rest, '>') - 2)
  FROM tag_parts
  WHERE rest LIKE '<%>%'
)
SELECT DISTINCT tag
FROM tag_parts
WHERE tag IS NOT NULL AND tag <> ''
ORDER BY tag;
